train: Original train partition, excluding every reserved localization worker
development: Original dev partition, excluding every reserved localization worker; already consumed in v1, adaptive development only
reservation: Original test and all three reserved localization workers remain unused
families: Intent and ordered slot roles plus annotation-derived typed input template for slotted rows; no-slot rows retain intent families. Proposal scaffolding from train only, never test annotations at inference.
selection: Highest exact development matches, then fewest rules, then policy order
normalization: Lowercase, collapse whitespace, remove terminal .?! from utterance and slot values. No translation, dictionaries, LLM or semantic preprocessing.
metrics: Exact intent plus all ordered slot values; intentions/slots/strata reported separately. All abstentions count.
scope: Adapted development experiment after poor v1. Typed-template grouping is supplied supervision, not autonomous concept discovery. Does not close M1. Reserved test/localizers untouched; no LLM comparison, RSS or energy measurement.
